name: Traceable old plans, and simple structures with published measurements
about: Two kinds of research for the 3D models. plan_sources: plans that show stones or posts one by one in publications now out of copyright (antiquarian works whose authors died over 70 years ago; Crown publications more than 50 years old), with the scan, the page or plate, scale, north arrow and what they show. sites: Irish-type round towers (Glendalough, Kildare, Ardmore, Clondalkin, Brechin, Abernethy) and brochs (Dun Carloway, Clickimin, Dun Telve, Dun Troddan) for models built from dimensions alone. Imperial figures are kept as printed; scan page numbers are the Internet Archive's 0-based leaf index (n), and PDF pages are 1-based.
